integrity: All finite classifications were independently replayed in two exact-integer implementations; the submitted polynomial certificate covers all 252 five-car frequency orbits. The Pollak symmetry statement is cited prior work. No external independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Classification applies only to classical parking functions with one through five cars. It gives no result for larger sizes or other parking-function variants. The earliest public source date labels the archival motivating literature, not the date of this new theorem.
title: The first non-symmetry Fourier zeros of classical parking functions
